market_question: Will Renan Santos finish in second place in the first round of the 2026 Brazilian presidential election?
reasoning: Renan Santos is a political activist with no significant electoral base, no gubernatorial or senatorial experience, and is not featured in any credible 2026 presidential polls. Historically, Brazil's second-place finishers are major-party candidates like governors or former presidents; the chance of an obscure outsider finishing second is negligible. The market price of 7.3% greatly overstates his true odds.
evidence_points: No major Brazilian poll (e.g., Datafolha, Ipec) lists Renan Santos as a candidate or shows him with >1% support.
The 2026 race is expected to be dominated by Lula/PT and a strong right‑wing contender such as Tarcísio de Freitas, leaving no opening for a minor left‑wing figure.
Renan Santos has never held elected office and lacks the party machinery needed to secure a second‑place finish against established political forces.
sources_consulted: Recent Datafolha and Ipec polls (early 2025) showing Lula and Tarcísio leading
News archives on Renan Santos's political background (Mídia Ninja, PSOL)
Historical results of Brazilian presidential elections (2018, 2022)
